title: AI keeps lying to you? Let me help.
description: AI keeps lying to you? Let me help.
transcript: AI lies to you all the time. They call it hallucination. Everything that you've said before influences its decision on what it's going to tell you. So, even though you ask it a straightforward [music] question, it'll get it wrong. And the worst part is you tell it it was wrong, it goes, "Oh, I'm sorry. Let me give you the real answer." Well, why didn't you give me the right answer from the beginning? Well, what you need to do is build a system prompt to avoid all this by making it [music] check its own work. And that's why I built this eight-part prompt that keeps it honest. I tell it to do things like, "Be explicit when uncertain. Stop assuming context and way freaking more." If you want it, just comment truth below and I'll send it right over to [music] you. That way you can copy and paste it into any custom instruction and have it stop lying to you.
